newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Thursday that around 2,200 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Wednesday.
Through Presidio, Texas, around 1,200 steer calves were sold mostly steady compared to last week. "Trade moderate, demand good," USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 94-104 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 84-94 cents/lb.

Through Nogales, Ariz., around 1,000 head were sold also mostly at steady prices compared to last week. "Trade moderate, demand moderate. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 92-102 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 82-92 cents/lb.
